summary: Verified iter382 follow-up CSS containment fix on BidVex homepage. All three containment styles are applied at runtime as spec'd (hero='layout paint', 3 blobs='size layout paint', particle container='strict'). HOWEVER the CLS regression is NOT fixed — total CLS on mobile 390x780 scroll journey = 0.8617 (target <0.1). Top shift = 0.6272 emitted BY the 600x600 center blob + particle DIVs at 1759ms; #2 shift = 0.2256 emitted by the FOOTER at 1170ms. Root cause: `contain` isolates an element's INTERNAL changes from affecting OUTSIDE the element — it does NOT prevent the element itself from being moved by its parent growing. The hero <section> uses `min-h-[90vh]` (not a fixed size), so as fonts/content stream in the hero grows in height, which (a) shifts the center blob (positioned via top:50% + translate) and the particles (top:X%) inside it, and (b) pushes the footer/every section below it downward. Both movements are recorded as layout-shift entries regardless of `contain: layout paint` because containment does not stop the parent from resizing and moving children. Homepage otherwise loads 200 OK, no console errors, hero visible, cookie banner shown, EN/FR toggle present.

ui_bugs.issue: CLS remains 0.8617 (target <0.1). CSS `contain: layout paint` applied correctly but does NOT fix the shifts because the hero uses `min-h-[90vh]` and grows as content loads. Growing parent moves the center blob (top:50% translate) and particle divs, emitting a 0.6272 shift; also pushes footer down, emitting 0.2256 shift.

action_items: The `contain` property alone will NEVER fix this CLS. Containment isolates internal changes from OUTSIDE, but here the shifts are caused by the PARENT (hero) growing and moving its absolutely-positioned children + everything below it. Real fixes: (1) Give the hero a FIXED height like `h-[90vh]` instead of `min-h-[90vh]` so it cannot grow after initial paint — this stops footer shift AND blob/particle repositioning. (2) OR pre-reserve space for hero content: set explicit width/height on the hero , use font-display:optional or preload the primary font, and eliminate any late-loaded content that expands the hero. (3) Additionally add `contain: size` (or `contain: strict`) to the hero itself once its size is fixed — currently only `layout paint` is set, which does NOT contain size changes.

The center blob at top-1/2 left-1/2 with -translate uses percentage positioning that literally repositions when the parent height changes. Even after fixing the hero height, consider anchoring blob with fixed pixel top/left instead of top-1/2 translate — reduces recomputation cost.

Footer shift 0.2256 at 1170ms confirms hero grew ~250-300px after initial paint. Investigate what loads late in hero (fonts? animated headline? badge?) and reserve its space with min-height on the inner content wrapper.
critical_code_review_comments: Fundamental misunderstanding of CSS `contain` in iter382/383 attempts: `contain: layout paint` prevents descendants' layout/paint from affecting ancestors, but it does NOT prevent the element from being resized by its parent or from moving its own descendants when the element itself changes size. Setting `contain: layout paint size` on the blob is applied but has no effect on the shift because the blob is being MOVED (translated position changes) by its parent growing — not shifting due to its own internal reflow.
The hero section uses `min-h-[90vh]` — this is the actual root cause. Any content that expands beyond 90vh (or any post-load content addition) will grow the section and cascade shifts everywhere.

Particle divs (20 of them, absolutely positioned inside `contain:strict` container) still appear in the shift sources list — confirms `contain:strict` does not stop children from emitting shift entries when their computed position changes due to viewport/parent resize.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://prod-verify-2.preview.emergentagent.com/. To measure CLS: page.add_init_script installing PerformanceObserver({type:'layout-shift', buffered:true}) BEFORE goto, then scroll mobile 390x780 top-to-bottom in ~400px steps with 350ms pauses, sum entry.value where !hadRecentInput. Sources of top shifts on this run: (#1) 600x600 center blob at top-1/2 + all 20 particle divs at 1759ms = 0.6272; (#2) footer at 1170ms = 0.2256; (#3) svg small = 0.0018. Applied contain confirmed: hero='layout paint', 3 blobs='size layout paint', particle container='strict'. Fix strategy that will actually work: convert hero from `min-h-[90vh]` to fixed `h-[90vh]` (or explicit px) so it cannot grow, THEN also add `contain: size` to hero to enforce it. Also pre-reserve space for any dynamic hero content (img dimensions, font metrics).
rca of the issue: CSS `contain: layout paint` on hero + `contain: size layout paint` on blobs + `contain: strict` on particle container is a NO-OP against this CLS because: layout-shift entries are emitted whenever an element's rendered rect changes between frames (unless recent user input). The hero uses `min-h-[90vh]` and its content grows post-first-paint (likely font swap or late component mount inside hero) — the hero itself expands vertically. This expansion (a) changes the computed pixel position of the absolutely-positioned center blob (top:50% + translate-y-1/2) and the 20 particles (top:X%), which are recorded as shifts on those children (0.6272), and (b) pushes down every sibling section including footer (0.2256). `contain` does not freeze an element's own size unless you use `contain: size` or `contain: strict` AND supply an intrinsic size — but here we can't set `contain: size` on the hero because its size is content-driven (min-h). Mitigation: replace `min-h-[90vh]` with `h-[90vh]` (fixed) OR reserve space for whatever late-loading hero content is expanding it (font-display:optional, image width/height attrs, min-height on inner wrapper). Only after the hero's height stops changing will the blob/particle/footer shifts stop.
